author: pawandhananjay
content: this is helpful. So seacast is more of an alternative for 8411 rather than waggle. Is that accurate?

author: cskiraly
content:
It is a bit more nuanced than that:
- on waggle: it is not an alternative, if we share the same understanding of Waggle
- 8411: Seacast is not an alternative to 8411. 8411 is a joint EIP to which different EIP authors have different ideas. Kamil has one, I have another one. There are technical differences between the two. Mine happens to derive from the line of work of FullDAS (sampled segmented erasure coded broadcast), cell-level messaging, Batch publishing, Informed Diffusion, Seacast, 8411. For his version he is the one to say, that's not on me 🙂

Anyway, this is not the right place to discuss the technicalities. We should do these in the networking repos and forums, otherwise it becomes just a communication mess.
